Programming & DSA.notes: Legacy CS bias removed. Now tests logic/tracing, not algorithm design.

Database Management.notes: Significant 2026 increase. Tests relational algebra, SQL, normalization, warehousing.

Artificial Intelligence.notes: High volatility. 2025 was anomalously low. Bayesian networks when included.
